name: The Yokohama Bay Hotel Tokyu
accessSummary: Directly connected to Minatomirai Station on the Minatomirai Line, about 1 min walk / about 10 min walk from Sakuragicho Station (JR lines and Yokohama Municipal Subway)
hours: Meetings are charged at the rate for up to 2 hours, with an additional fee for each extra hour. Dining is charged at the rate for up to 2 hours. Exhibitions are charged at the daily rate for 9:00-21:00. Use before 9:00 and after 22:00 is charged at the regular fee plus 50%. (Price list as of July 1, 2026)
notice: The amounts in the banquet room price list include service charge and taxes. Prices may change depending on the season and conditions of use. The Queen's Square Yokohama connecting passage at Minatomirai Station is closed from 24:00 to 7:00; during these hours, use Exit 5 to reach the main entrance.

rooms.name: Queens Grand Ballroom (entire A-B-C-D)
rooms.note: B2F. Large banquet room. Can be divided into 4 sections, A to D. In the capacity columns, banquet = seated dinner, standing = buffet.

rooms.name: Ambassador's Ballroom (SN)
rooms.note: B2F. Medium banquet room. Can be divided into 2 sections, S and N.

rooms.name: Rose
rooms.note: B2F. Small banquet room. Seated dinner only.

rooms.name: Pacific Room
rooms.note: 25F. Small banquet room. A party room with a view over Yokohama Port.

rooms.name: Business Lounge
rooms.note: 24F. Meeting room. Capacity 10 people, layout is free-flow.

rooms.name: The Library
rooms.note: 23F. Meeting room. Capacity 10 people, layout is free-flow.

ops.parking: For hotel parking, use the underground parking lot of Queen's Square Yokohama (which has a dedicated hotel entrance). It is open 7:00-24:00 with 1,700 spaces, at 280 yen per 30 minutes. The maximum charge is 1,600 yen on weekdays and 2,000 yen on Sat, Sun & holidays (when exiting by 24:00 on the day of entry; excluding Jan 1-3, Dec 24, 25 and 31). Attendees of weddings and banquets get 3 hours free.
ops.waitingRooms: The small banquet room "Rose" (B2F, 30㎡, seated dinner for 10) can also be used as a waiting room when a banquet room is used.
